title: Quick-Fix Australian Fish Pavlova
description: A Whole30-friendly, Australian-inspired dessert made with a shio-koji cure, coriander seeds, and a meringue base, finished with fresh tropical fruit.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix the shio-koji powder and coriander seeds together, then rub all over the mackerel fillets.
Place the mackerel on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 12 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the mackerel is baking, whip the egg whites and granulated sugar until stiff peaks form.
Add the salt and continue whipping until combined.
Spoon the meringue mixture onto the prepared baking sheet, shaping into a round base for the pavlova.
Bake the meringue for 1.5 hours, or until crispy and dry.
Remove the meringue from the oven and let cool completely.
Cut the cooked mackerel into thin slices.
Arrange the meringue base on a serving plate, then top with the mackerel slices, passionfruit, kiwi, and strawberries.
Drizzle the coconut cream over the top and garnish with fresh mint leaves.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
